# The builtin min and max of integers map to the simd Min and Max methods; a
# clamp is a max under a min. Floats are left alone (see
# min_max_float_no_rewrite.txt).

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func ReluInt32s(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = max(a[i], 0)
	}
}

func ClampInt32s(dst, a []int32, lo, hi int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = min(max(a[i], lo), hi)
	}
}

func MinUint8s(dst, a, b []uint8) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = min(a[i], b[i])
	}
}

func FloorInt16s(a []int16, floor int16) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = max(floor, a[i])
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func ReluInt32s(dst, a []int32) {
	_vcInt32s0 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(0)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = max(a[i], 0)
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(a[_i:])
				_v1.Max(_vcInt32s0).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func ClampInt32s(dst, a []int32, lo, hi int32) {
	_vcAInt32s1 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(lo)
	_vcBInt32s1 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(hi)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = min(max(a[i], lo), hi)
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(a[_i:])
				_v1.Max(_vcAInt32s1).Min(_vcBInt32s1).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func MinUint8s(dst, a, b []uint8) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, b) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = min(a[i], b[i])
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			_ = b[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadUint8sPart(a[_i:])
				_v2, _ := simd.LoadUint8sPart(b[_i:])
				_v1.Min(_v2).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func FloorInt16s(a []int16, floor int16) {
	_vcInt16s3 := simd.BroadcastInt16s(floor)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(a); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt16sPart(a[_i:])
		_v1.Max(_vcInt16s3).StorePart(a[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T) bool {
	if len(a) == 0 || len(b) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	aStart := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	aEnd := aStart + uintptr(len(a))*unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	bStart := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	bEnd := bStart + uintptr(len(b))*unsafe.Sizeof(b[0])
	return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	a := []int32{-5, 0, 3, 100, -2147483648, 2147483647, 7, -1, 42}
	dst := make([]int32, len(a))
	test.ReluInt32s(dst, a)
	fmt.Println(dst)
	test.ClampInt32s(dst, a, -3, 50)
	fmt.Println(dst)

	x := []uint8{0, 1, 200, 255, 7, 128, 127}
	y := []uint8{5, 1, 100, 254, 7, 129, 0}
	out := make([]uint8, len(x))
	test.MinUint8s(out, x, y)
	fmt.Println(out)

	f := []int16{-32768, -1, 0, 1, 32767, -100}
	test.FloorInt16s(f, -50)
	fmt.Println(f)
}
-- testmain/output --
[0 0 3 100 0 2147483647 7 0 42]
[-3 0 3 50 -3 50 7 -1 42]
[0 1 100 254 7 128 0]
[-50 -1 0 1 32767 -50]
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 4 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func ReluInt32s(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = max(a[i], 0)
	}
}

func ClampInt32s(dst, a []int32, lo, hi int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = min(max(a[i], lo), hi)
	}
}

func MinUint8s(dst, a, b []uint8) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = min(a[i], b[i])
	}
}

func FloorInt16s(a []int16, floor int16) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = max(floor, a[i])
	}
}
